text:
Aisha: Quick sync — FinSolve asked for reserved-pool onboarding for Q2. They want: predictable baseline (16 vGPU), up to 2x burst for 2 one-hour windows/day, and a pricing ladder by commit length. Need acceptance criteria + launch gating by EOD Friday.
Tom: We can do 2x burst but only if we have prewarm and KV-cache priming. Without that p95 will spike.
Diego: Pricing note — they pushed back on a minimum 12mo commit. Would consider 3mo + higher per-token for burst.
Riley: Onboarding checklist: contract signed, network peering, SOC2 attestation on file, test prompt set, and runbook handoff to CS.
Sam: Autoscale constraints — recommend: prewarm window = 10 minutes, scale step = +50% every 30s, cooldown = 5m. Otherwise we oscillate.
Aisha: Good. Can we convert Sam/Tom suggestions into a concrete acceptance test? Need clear pass/fail for the Sales team.
Tom: Acceptance test idea: simulate 2x steady-state traffic for 60m with 2 scheduled 1h bursts; p95 latency must remain < 200ms and error rate < 0.5%. Also measure token cost delta.
Diego: Sales asks for a pricing ladder doc sample. Suggested tiers: [A] 3mo commit = baseline price + burst surcharge 30% (on burst tokens); [B] 6mo = baseline -10%, burst surcharge 20%; [C] 12mo = baseline -20%, burst free for up to 1h/day.
Riley: Also require runbook entry: failover path if reserved pool exhausted -> route to compatible open model with graceful degradation. CS will own golden prompts for fallout verification.
Aisha: Can we show an example SLA fragment for the customer? I'll include it in the term sheet.
Tom: Example SLA config (dev note):
```
SLA: {
  uptime: "99.9%",
  p95_latency: "200ms",
  burst_guarantee: "2x for two 1h windows/day",
  error_rate_threshold: "0.5%"
}
```
Diego: We should attach a surcharge table for burst beyond guaranteed windows. Also include a one-time prewarm fee to cover warm-up allocations.
Sam: Ops concern: prewarm fee should map to a predictable GPU-hours quota. If prewarm invoked daily, cost = prewarm_hours * gpu_hour_rate. Recommend telemetry label: finSolve.prewarm.daily_hours.
Riley: We'll need a customer acceptance script for CS to run during cutover. Steps: 1) run agreed prompt set at baseline for 30m; 2) run burst simulation; 3) validate rollout canary and fallback. I'll author and attach.
Aisha: OK — next steps: Tom+Sam produce a short tech spec with the autoscale knobs + test script by Wednesday. Diego to draft pricing ladder and prewarm fee options by Thursday. Riley to draft acceptance script and runbook by Thursday. I'll own final term sheet + launch gating.
Tom: Also propose a small canary on day-1: 10% traffic through reserved, monitor p95 and error rate for 2h before full cutover.
Diego: Fine with that. Also request we add a checkbox for billing integration: confirm invoice tag and metering labels.
deploy-bot: Reminder: schedule meeting "FinSolve reserved-pool kickoff" added to #product calendar for 2026-03-27 10:00.
Aisha: Thanks everyone. I'll send the meeting notes with action owners after Tom/Diego/Riley post their drafts. :thumbsup:
- ACTIONS:
  - Tom & Sam: tech spec + autoscale config + test script (due Wed)
  - Diego: pricing ladder + prewarm fee options (due Thu)
  - Riley: acceptance script + runbook excerpt (due Thu)
  - Aisha: term sheet + launch gating (collect drafts and finalize by Fri)
